title: STARTUP Cultural Places Dataset
description: Art and cultural places in European cities, curated for the STARTUP project (Horizon Europe). Covers eight cities/regions: Dortmund/Bochum/Gelsenkirchen (Ruhr), Madrid, Stockholm, Rome, Gdańsk, Sevilla, Trenčín, and Eurométropole de Strasbourg. Combines data from the Overture Maps Foundation places theme (release 2025-05-21.0) with locally curated submissions, filtered by official Eurostat GISCO LAU 2024 and Etalab EPCI boundaries.
